2607.07189.title: Does AI Understand Imaging? A Systematic Benchmark of Agentic AI for Computational Imaging Tasks
2607.07189.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and agentic AI have shown strong performance on semantic visual tasks, but it remains unclear whether they can handle the physics and inverse problems that underlie computational imaging. We present ImagingBench, a benchmark of 20 computational imaging tasks spanning five categories: ray and wave optics, image signal processing, inverse reconstruction, computational sensing, and calibration. ImagingBench evaluates three complementary settings: Expert, fixed expert-guided inverse reconstruction; Planner, planner-guided inverse reconstruction; and Forward, forward-system simulation for consistency checking. We benchmark leading proprietary and open-source image-centric multimodal systems, including Gemini, GPT, and Qwen, and compare them with representative task-specific non-agentic baselines. Across tasks, agentic models remain consistently weaker than specialized methods, especially on computational sensing problems such as lensless imaging, event-based reconstruction, time-of-flight imaging, and holography. Planner guidance provides only modest and inconsistent gains over the fixed-prompt Expert baseline. Although the models often generate visually plausible outputs, their reference-based fidelity remains poor, revealing a substantial gap between semantic visual competence and physically grounded imaging performance. ImagingBench provides a unified testbed for measuring this gap and tracking progress in agentic AI for computational imaging.
2607.07189.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）和代理型人工智慧在語意視覺任務上表現出色，但尚不清楚它們是否能處理計算成像所需的物理學和反演問題。我們提出了ImagingBench，這是一個涵蓋五個類別的20個計算成像任務的基準：光線和波動光學、影像信號處理、反演重建、計算感測和校準。ImagingBench評估三個互補的設定：專家，固定專家引導的反演重建；規劃者，規劃者引導的反演重建；以及前向，前向系統模擬以進行一致性檢查。我們基準測試了領先的專有和開源影像中心多模態系統，包括Gemini、GPT和Qwen，並將它們與具有代表性的任務特定非代理基準進行比較。在各項任務中，代理模型的表現始終不如專業方法，特別是在計算感測問題上，如無鏡頭成像、事件驅動重建、飛行時間成像和全息學。規劃者引導僅提供對固定提示專家基準的適度和不一致的增益。儘管這些模型經常生成視覺上合理的輸出，但它們基於參考的保真度仍然較差，顯示出語意視覺能力與物理基礎成像性能之間存在顯著差距。ImagingBench提供了一個統一的測試平台，用於測量這一差距並追蹤代理型人工智慧在計算成像方面的進展。
